changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard forms (RoBERTa, BERT), removed redundant/unclear model names, consolidated output descriptions, and added all pre-trained model variants tested in the paper.
No changes needed - 'solution accuracy' is correctly extracted and properly normalized.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper uses pre-trained models (BERT, RoBERTa) as part of the generation architecture, not for post-generation evaluation.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. The paper only uses automatic evaluation metrics (solution accuracy).

overall_notes: This paper focuses on Math Word Problem solving using a novel RPKHS architecture that combines pre-trained language model knowledge with hierarchical reasoning. The paper properly belongs to NLG evaluation as it generates mathematical equations from natural language problem descriptions. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization of model names and addition of all tested pre-trained model variants.
